meta.notes: POST /webhook/security-analysis — Fetches the full Flowsint graph, extracts target intelligence, and calls Analysis LLM (via llm-gateway -> vLLM). The full Campaign Objectives (target type/name, additional identifiers, company email, mission & ROE) are injected into the LLM SYSTEM PROMPT as the PRIMARY analysis criteria, so the model correlates ingested data against the assessment goals. Returns JSON: { targets[], objective_alignment, scenarios[] (each with an 'objective' field), summary, individuals_count, breach_intel[], attack_surface[] }. attack_surface is built from Domain Recon assets (WebAsset/CloudAsset/Service/Subdomain) and their MANAGES owners; it is injected into the LLM system prompt as EXTERNAL ATTACK SURFACE and bumps the score of individuals who manage exposed/cloud assets. Body: { campaign_id, campaign_name, target_type, target_name, additional_ids, company_email, company_email_domain, mission_statement }. Now also traverses HAS_BREACH -> FlareBreach and HAS_CREDENTIAL -> credential edges so the analysis incorporates Flare breach results, credential-to-user relationships, and CONFIRMED-COMPROMISED (validated) credentials: these feed target scoring (cred/breach bumps), a new '## COMPROMISED CREDENTIALS & BREACH INTELLIGENCE' system-prompt section + instruction, and a new credential_intel[] response array (plus enriched breach_intel[] with event types, stealer malware, plaintext-exposure and breach-x-cred flags).
